response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse_rate FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) as overall_avg FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), first_filter AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages ta CROSS JOIN overall_avg_calc oac WHERE ta.avg_pulse_rate > oac.overall_avg), second_avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as second_avg FROM first_filter), final_set AS (SELECT ff.avg_pulse_rate FROM first_filter ff CROSS JOIN second_avg_calc sac WHERE ff.avg_pulse_rate > sac.second_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) as mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT overall_avg FROM overall_avg_calc)) as avg_above_overall, AVG(avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT second_avg FROM second_avg_calc)) as avg_above_second FROM final_set
